description: Roomingo locations v1 contract. cities/<city>.json: { $schemaVersion, city, state, updatedAt, areas: [{name, slug, microOf?} | string] }. index.json: { $schemaVersion, updatedAt, cities: [{city, state, areaCount, file, updatedAt}] }. Rules: apps ignore unknown fields; renames change name never slug; areaCount must equal areas.length.
